parameters.lede: Designs are checked against these rules. A hard rule blocks a submit. A soft rule shows a badge.
parameters.formError: Fix the fields marked below to continue.

closesAt.label: Last day to design and vote
closesAt.help: Leave empty to close the project by hand.

budgetTotal.label: Total budget in dollars
budgetTotal.help: Designs that cost more than this are over budget.

cutPerM3.label: Cut cost per m³ in dollars
cutPerM3.help: What it costs to dig out 1 m³ of soil.

fillPerM3.label: Fill cost per m³ in dollars
fillPerM3.help: What it costs to bring in and pack 1 m³ of soil.

haulPerM3.label: Haul cost per m³ in dollars
haulPerM3.help: What it costs to truck 1 m³ of extra soil off the site.

canopyMin.label: Tree canopy minimum in percent
canopyMin.help: The share of the park that tree crowns must cover.

imperviousMax.label: Hard surface maximum in percent
imperviousMax.help: The largest share of the park that paving and buildings can cover.

gardenMinPlots.label: Community garden plots, fewest
gardenMinPlots.default: Default: 20 plots (the garden has 56 plots today)

maxRunningSlope.label: Path running slope maximum in percent
maxRunningSlope.help: The steepest a path can climb along its length.

maxCrossSlope.label: Path cross slope maximum in percent
maxCrossSlope.help: The steepest a path can tilt from side to side.

maxDeviationM.label: Cut or fill depth maximum in metres
maxDeviationM.help: The most a design can raise or lower the ground at any point.

maxNetHaulM3.label: Net soil hauled maximum in m³
maxNetHaulM3.help: The most soil a design can truck on or off the site. Leave it empty for no limit.

maxDisturbedPercent.label: Ground disturbed maximum in percent
maxDisturbedPercent.help: The largest share of the park a design can regrade. Leave it empty for no limit.

rootZonePerDbhCm.label: Root zone in metres per cm of trunk
rootZonePerDbhCm.help: Designs cannot grade inside this radius around a locked tree.
rootZonePerDbhCm.default: Default: 0.12 m per cm (ISA critical root zone rule of 12 times trunk width)

brief.label: Design brief
brief.help: Residents read this before they design, so name what the park needs.
brief.default: Default: the Jonathan Rogers Park brief

priorUp.label: Ranking start, up votes
priorUp.help: Early votes then count for less.

priorDown.label: Ranking start, down votes
priorDown.help: Balances the order the same way.

counts.help: Leave a box empty for no limit.

severity.default: Default: garden plots and forbidden zones are hard, the rest soft (CommonGround default)

messages.minAboveMax: Enter a most that is at least the fewest.

parameters.more: Show more rules: costs, slopes, earthworks, trees, counts, voting and hard or soft

refine.drawing: Drag a rectangle on the ground to draw the zone.
refine.desktopOnly: The editor needs a screen 1024 px wide or more. Use a desktop to refine the baseline.

publish.lede: Publishing opens the project. Residents can then start designs from this baseline and vote.
publish.nameHelp: Residents see this on the list they choose from.
publish.failed: The project did not publish. Review each step and try again.
publish.pictureFailed: {name} is open to residents. Its picture did not save.
